claims.text: The City of Atlanta zoning layer (layer 0), queried over the parcel's bounding box (-84.3560,33.6486 to -84.3498,33.6519), returns a single district: R-4, Single Family Residential, part of a 284.6-acre R-4 polygon. A single-family district does not list warehouse or industrial use; industrial use would need a rezoning (e.g. to I-1/I-2).

open_items: The R-4 use table is on Municode (not fetchable by policy here); a person should confirm R-4 permits no warehouse/distribution use, and what an R-4 to I-1/I-2 rezoning would need.
The zoning record carries no conditional-zoning case number (CASEIN/CASEOUT blank), so no conditions are recorded on this polygon in the layer.

The 'Industrial' value the screener read is the older LANDUSEDES field carried on the same record (marked as a technical conversion), not the current pattern.
Same answer: the current development pattern name on the polygon covering the parcel is Low Density Residential.
The layer's own metadata shows its map is drawn on the NDP field under the heading 'Development Pattern', i.e. NDP (here LDR) is the shown future land use, not LANDUSEDES.
The service lists the older future land use layer as deprecated, consistent with the 'Industrial' value being legacy.
The rezoning-cases layer (layer 10), queried over the parcel's bounding box, returns no case: no rezoning is recorded on the parcel.

The rezoning-cases layer queried over a wider box around the parcel (-84.3610,33.6440 to -84.3450,33.6565, roughly 500-800 m out) returns only two old cases, Z-09-001 (RG2 to MR-3-C, 2009) and Z-06-095 (OI to C-1-C, 2006); none in the last five years.
The building-moratorium layer (layer 5), queried over the parcel's bounding box, returns no feature: no moratorium mapped on the parcel.

open_items: Confirm with Atlanta City Planning that the adopted CDP (Plan A, reported adopted July 2025) shows Low Density Residential here; an industrial project would need a CDP amendment as well as a rezoning.
The rezoning-case layer was last edited in 2024 on the records seen; cases filed since may not be mapped. Check recent ZRB agendas for Red Oak Dr SE.
